difficulty_reason: The lemma proves two statements about the functor taking a morphism into x to a morphism into y along a ring map: minimal objects go to minimal objects, and along a surjection every minimal object of the target category is the image of a minimal object of the source category (statement lines 4321-4333). The proof (proof lines 4335-4372) reduces competing morphisms in the target to the source using (S1) and forces the comparison to be an isomorphism by minimality, and in the other direction lifts along the surjection and controls the result by minimality. H2: two implications with three inputs, written out in full.
